title: Training Note: Kept-Order Points on Northgate Special Order Settlement Restocking
content:
This training note explains one element of the settlement restocking fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership: how much of the order the member keeps.

## The rule

Kept-order points: when, after the refund, the units still kept on the purchase are 80 percent or more of the units sold on it, 1.5 percentage points are taken off; when they are 50 percent or more but less than 80 percent, 0.5 point is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

- **Units sold** are the units of every sale line on the purchase, added together.
- **Units still kept after the refund** are the units sold less every unit refunded on the purchase, the units of the changed-mind refund just posted included.
- The points taken off reduce the single percentage applied to the changed-mind refund.

| Kept units as a share of units sold, after the refund | Points taken off the rate |
|---|---|
| 0.8 (80 percent) or more | 1.5 |
| 0.5 (50 percent) or more, less than 0.8 | 0.5 |
| less than 0.5 | none |

## Questions answered by the rule (hypothetical purchases)

- *A purchase sold 10 units; with this refund 2 have been refunded in all. What is taken off?* 8 of 10 are kept, exactly 80 percent: 1.5 points.
- *Same purchase, 3 refunded in all?* 7 of 10, 70 percent: 0.5 point.
- *5 refunded in all?* 5 of 10, exactly 50 percent: 0.5 point.
- *6 refunded in all?* 4 of 10, 40 percent: nothing.
- *Do earlier refunds for other reasons count?* Yes; every unit refunded on the purchase reduces the units kept.
